title: AGCP Common Types
description: Shared JSON Schema definitions actively required by the AGCP v2.0 schema set. This clean library contains only definitions referenced by implemented schemas or by retained shared definitions; canonical domain objects and result objects are defined in their assigned DS schemas.
rtm_mapping_basis: RTM-00005 / CR-005 maps the canonical provenance wire schema and IF-001. RTM-00042, RTM-00052, RTM-00064, and RTM-00066 map the generic algorithm-explicit content-digest contract for replay, Canonical State, evidence, and receipt integrity.
notes: Canonical AGCP shared-definition library. Provenance is synchronized with the normative wire format. P1-12 binds every supported content-digest algorithm to an exact lowercase-hexadecimal output length and deprecates algorithm-implicit hash_hex for new contracts. Reverse dependency metadata remains synchronized to the active graph.

title: AGCP ErrorResponse
description: Standard error response for AGCP HTTP interfaces. Rejection codes SHALL be defined by the AGCP rejection-code registry.
rtm_mapping_basis: Existing GitHub_File references in RTM-1.6; DS_ID populated in RTM-1.7.
notes: v2.0.4 P1-03/P1-09 correction: public 404 is normalized to RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND; REQUEST_THROTTLED requires 429 plus Retry-After; CAPACITY_UNAVAILABLE uses 503; transport/service conditions are not Governance Outcomes.

title: AGCP Implementation Metadata Response
description: Canonical, attributable, integrity-protected implementation-capability and release-advertisement response for AGCP interface discovery. DS-003 identifies the implementation release, supported AGCP specification releases, complete integrity-bound schema set, implementation profile, supported registry releases, claimed conformance levels and scope, supported governance capabilities, and implemented HTTP contract without expanding normative behavior, creating authority, or implying conformance beyond demonstrated evidence.
rtm_mapping_basis: Direct implementation-conformance discovery mapping for claimed AGCP semantics and cross-implementation interoperability; DS-003 exposes explicit release, profile, schema-set, registry, conformance, capability, and interface evidence.
notes: v2.0.4 P1-14/P1-17 correction: metadata advertises immutable baseline and profile digests, schema and validator-set integrity, active governance version, IF-001 identity, and optional public-safe deployment binding.

title: AGCP Tenant Governance Record
description: Canonical, attributable, versioned, integrity-protected Tenant governance record. DS-004 records the authoritative Tenant operational state and state version, append-only state history and transition basis, active and historical Governance Configuration versions, Tenant Governance Evidence, explicit Tenant and Governance Domain Isolation controls, registry bindings, and complete record integrity. It does not itself establish authority at commitment, authorize execution, or override Canonical State.
rtm_mapping_basis: Direct implementation of Tenant operational-state enforcement and Tenant/Governance Domain Isolation, including current-state checks at evaluation and commitment, cross-tenant visibility/authority/execution/policy/evidence isolation, and attributable state/configuration history.
notes: Comprehensively updated for AGCP v2.0. DS-004 now records authoritative Tenant state and version, append-only attributable state history and transition basis, active and historical Governance Configuration versions, Tenant Governance Evidence, explicit isolation controls, registry bindings, provenance, signature, digest, and replay material. Unrestricted metadata and the shared Tenant-state alias were removed.

title: Policy Evaluation Module Artifact
description: Canonical attributable, versioned, integrity-protected Policy Evaluation Module artifact binding deterministic runtime representation and interface contract to source policies, Governance Configuration, validated compilation, dependency and lineage evidence, Constitutional Validation, Governance Omission Analysis, Governance Self-Protection, Controlled Governance Activation, and Governance Version.
rtm_mapping_basis: Contextual and implementation-specific realization of Governance Compilation, deterministic Compilation Context, Compiled Governance Artifact validation, protected-governance preservation, omission analysis, self-protection, and Controlled Governance Activation for Policy Evaluation Modules.
notes: Comprehensively updated for AGCP v2.0. DS-005 owns the canonical Policy Evaluation Module artifact and integrity-bound reference. It records deterministic runtime and interface contracts; source policy, configuration, registry, compilation-context, build, dependency, lineage, validation, self-protection, activation, Governance Version, evidence, integrity, and replay bindings without itself establishing authority, admissibility, execution authorization, activation, or commitment.

title: Governance Policy Artifact
description: Canonical attributable, versioned, integrity-protected Governance Policy artifact that declares deterministic policy semantics and required governance inputs; binds policy to Governance Configuration; and references DS-042 compilation and DS-043 activation without itself establishing authority, admissibility, execution authorization, activation, or commitment.
rtm_mapping_basis: Direct mapping to CR-007 and relationship-specific contextual mappings to governance compilation, protected-policy preservation, omission analysis, and self-modification isolation requirements in RTM-1.30.
notes: Comprehensively updated for v2.0 as the canonical policy-intent artifact. Owns the integrity-bound policy reference used by active schemas and directly references DS-041, DS-042, and DS-043.

title: Governance Constraint Artifact
description: Canonical attributable, versioned, integrity-protected governance constraint artifact with source lineage, deterministic semantics, protected or constitutional classification, Governance Configuration binding, DS-042 compilation and validation projection, DS-043 controlled activation, Governance Version, and explicit non-weakening semantics.
rtm_mapping_basis: Direct mapping to CR-063 and relationship-specific contextual mappings to governance compilation, constitutional validation and preservation, Governance Self-Protection, omission analysis, and self-modification isolation requirements in RTM-1.32.
notes: Comprehensively updated for v2.0. DS-007 owns the canonical integrity-bound constraint reference used by active schemas; generic shared aliases and unconstrained metadata were removed. Reverse schema dependency metadata synchronized to the active forward schema_dependencies graph in Schema Catalog 1.0.44.

title: Governance Invariant Definition
description: Canonical attributable, versioned, integrity-protected governance invariant definition preserving source specification and governance lineage, deterministic invariant semantics, protected or constitutional classification, enforcement level, non-weakening controls, Governance Configuration binding, DS-042 compilation and validation evidence, DS-043 controlled activation, Governance Version, evidence, integrity, and replay material.
rtm_mapping_basis: Direct mappings to hard-invariant failure, invariant-based Structural Refusal, required invariant references, and deterministic invariant evaluation; contextual mappings to Governance Compilation, Constitutional Validation, protected-invariant preservation, Governance Self-Protection, Governance Omission Analysis, and self-modification isolation.
notes: Comprehensively updated for AGCP v2.0 as the canonical invariant-definition artifact. DS-008 owns invariant identity, classification, enforcement level, integrity-bound references, deterministic semantics, source and artifact lineage, protected/constitutional non-weakening controls, compilation validation, controlled activation, Governance Version, evidence, and replay material.

title: Governance Exception Artifact
description: Canonical attributable, versioned, integrity-protected governance exception artifact permitting only narrowly scoped, time-bounded, authority-backed and externally approved modification of ordinary exceptionable constraint evaluation; protected and constitutional constraints and governance invariants cannot be overridden.
rtm_mapping_basis: Relationship-specific contextual mappings to Governance Compilation, Constitutional Validation and Preservation, Governance Self-Protection, Governance Omission Analysis, and Governance Self-Modification Isolation requirements in RTM-1.34.
notes: Comprehensively updated for AGCP v2.0. DS-009 owns the canonical integrity-bound exception reference, restricts exceptions to ordinary exceptionable constraints, requires current authority and external approval, and prohibits protected/constitutional weakening, invariant override, scope amplification, bypass, and self-activation.

title: Governance Artifact View
description: Canonical externally observable, integrity-protected read model for a governance artifact and its compilation, validation, approval, activation, Governance Version, lineage, evidence, and lifecycle state.
rtm_mapping_basis: Contextual read-model mapping to governance compilation, validation, self-protection, omission analysis, controlled activation, and self-modification isolation requirements.
notes: Comprehensively updated for v2.0 to project canonical DS-041, DS-042, and DS-043 state without duplicating or replacing authoritative records.

title: Governance Constraint Evaluation Result
description: Canonical, attributable, integrity-protected result of evaluating one DS-007 Governance Constraint Artifact for a specific Governed Action Proposal, Tenant, governance domain, target, evaluation horizon, Governance Version, and qualified governance-input set. DS-011 records applicability, deterministic condition evaluation, satisfied, violated, indeterminate, or not-applicable outcomes, resulting governance disposition, evidence, attribution, integrity, and replay material without itself authorizing execution or establishing authority at commitment.
rtm_mapping_basis: Direct and supporting mappings added for constraint-controlled authorization, governing-constraint identification, evidence integrity, attribution, replay, and deterministic evaluation.
notes: Comprehensively refactored for AGCP v2.0 with canonical Proposal, Constraint, Tenant/domain, target, evaluation horizon, Governance Version and Configuration, qualified-input digests, evidence, attribution, integrity, replay, and outcome-specific validation. Unrestricted metadata removed.

title: Governance Invariant Evaluation Result
description: Canonical, attributable, integrity-protected result of evaluating one DS-008 Governance Invariant Definition for a specific Governed Action Proposal, Proposal Identity, Tenant, governance domain, target, evaluation horizon, Governance Version, and qualified governance-input set. DS-012 records applicability, deterministic assertion evaluation, preserved, violated, indeterminate, or not-applicable outcomes, and explicitly identifies any resulting Structural Refusal, governed escalation, lifecycle effect, and Governance Evidence without itself authorizing execution or establishing authority at commitment.
rtm_mapping_basis: Semantic v2.0 mapping established during DS-012 comprehensive evaluation-result refactor.
notes: Canonical invariant-evaluation result with explicit Structural Refusal, escalation, lifecycle-effect, Governance Evidence, deterministic qualified-input binding, attribution, integrity, and replay semantics.

title: Proposal Submit Request
description: Normative transport wrapper for submitting one canonical Governed Action Proposal to an AGCP-conformant implementation. The wrapper supplies transport correlation and namespace-qualified extension data only; all governance-domain content is carried in proposal and validated by DS-021. Submission is not execution and does not confer authority at commitment.
rtm_mapping_basis: Existing GitHub_File references in RTM-1.6; DS_ID populated in RTM-1.7.
notes: Transport-only submission wrapper around DS-021. The former flattened domain fields are carried under the required proposal property. The obsolete top-level metadata compatibility member was removed; namespace-qualified extension data uses extensions.

title: Proposal View
description: Canonical externally observable view of a governed proposal. The view keeps authoritative Derived Lifecycle State separate from transient processing status and exposes canonical references to the proposal, context, state, authority, decisions, authorizations, commit attempts and results, evidence, receipts, refusals, composite-governance objects, enforcement, degradation, continuation, terminality, and replay-relevant history.
rtm_mapping_basis: Existing GitHub_File references in RTM-1.6; DS_ID populated in RTM-1.7.
notes: Step 5 refactor: authoritative lifecycle state is separated from transient processing status and the view now references canonical workflow and governance objects directly.

title: Governance Decision Result
description: Canonical, attributable, integrity-protected result produced by the Governance Decision Function after Proposal Qualification. The result binds the decision to the canonical proposal, target, Tenant, governance domain, policy and Governance Version, qualified Canonical State, qualified Governance Evidence, Authority Lineage, applicable constraints and invariants, approvals, evaluation horizon, and deterministic decision basis. Non-refusal outcomes require a DS-027 Governance Receipt; Structural Refusal requires a DS-028 Refusal Record.
rtm_mapping_basis: Exact DS-to-requirement assignments derived from the authoritative RTM-1.46 DS_ID column; the catalog records the corresponding RTM_ID and CR_ID sets without omission or addition.
notes: Step 5 refactor: canonical decision basis, qualified state and evidence, authority, constraints, invariants, attribution, receipt, and refusal relationships are structurally represented. Catalog ARM and NS mappings synchronized from the authoritative DS-015 schema annotation. RTM/CR traceability synchronized to RTM-1.46 by adding RTM-00034 and CR-034.

title: Execution Authorization View
description: Canonical externally observable representation of an AGCP Execution Authorization. It binds an authorization outcome to the canonical proposal, Governance Decision Result, target, Tenant, governance domain, policy and Governance Version, qualified Canonical State, qualified evidence, Authority Lineage, lifecycle, scope, and validity conditions. Execution Authorization is eligibility evidence for Commit Boundary processing; it is neither authority at commitment nor permission to execute.
rtm_mapping_basis: Exact DS-to-requirement assignments derived from the authoritative RTM-1.46 DS_ID column; the catalog records the corresponding RTM_ID and CR_ID sets without omission or addition.
notes: Step 5 refactor: target, scope, lifecycle, validity, state, evidence, authority, consumption, attribution, and non-executable authorization semantics are structurally represented. RTM/CR traceability synchronized to RTM-1.46 by adding RTM-00010 and CR-010.

title: Commit Boundary Request
description: Canonical integrity-protected request for Commit Boundary processing. It presents the specific canonical proposal, decision, Execution Authorization, current Authority Re-Derivation, qualified state and evidence, Resulting-State Validation, Governance Binding Validation, composite-governance results when applicable, and complete DS-029 Enforcement Context to a specific Policy Enforcement Point.
rtm_mapping_basis: Existing GitHub_File references in RTM-1.6; DS_ID populated in RTM-1.7.
notes: Step 5 refactor: Commit Boundary invocation now carries the complete canonical governance basis and DS-029 Enforcement Context.

title: Commit Boundary Result
description: Canonical attributable and integrity-protected result of Commit Boundary and Policy Enforcement Point processing. It records the exact request, proposal, decision, authorization, current authority, Governance Binding Validation, Resulting-State Validation, Enforcement Context, PEP outcome, executed transition set, lifecycle effect, Governance Evidence, Governance Receipt, and any Structural Refusal.
rtm_mapping_basis: Existing GitHub_File references in RTM-1.6; DS_ID populated in RTM-1.7.
notes: Step 5 refactor: Commit Boundary outcome now records canonical request, enforcement, executed subset, lifecycle effect, receipt, refusal, attribution, and replay material.

title: Governance Evidence
description: Canonical immutable Governance Evidence record. It contains typed evidence-item references, explicit ordering, integrity digests, attributable provenance-chain continuity, qualification results, Governance Ledger references, and links to canonical governance outcomes. Raw or arbitrary evidence payloads are not normative content; governance-significant evidence is represented through typed, resolvable, digest-bound artifact references.
rtm_mapping_basis: Existing GitHub_File references in RTM-1.6; DS_ID populated in RTM-1.7.
notes: Step 5 refactor: generic evidence payloads were replaced by typed, digest-bound evidence items with ordering, provenance continuity, qualification, ledger, receipt, and refusal relationships. Reverse schema dependency metadata synchronized to the active forward schema_dependencies graph in Schema Catalog 1.0.44.

title: Governed Action Proposal
description: Canonical domain schema for a governance-significant proposed transition submitted to AGCP runtime-governance evaluation. The object declares stable Proposal Identity, operational intent, target, requested effect, canonical Action Representation, associated Governance Context, provenance, temporal validity, and applicable composite-governance semantics. A Governed Action Proposal is not execution and does not confer authority at commitment.
rtm_mapping_basis: Exact DS-to-requirement assignments derived from the authoritative RTM-1.46 DS_ID column; the catalog records the corresponding RTM_ID and CR_ID sets without omission or addition.
notes: Canonical Governed Action Proposal. Composite proposals now reference canonical DS-035 Bind Set policy/reference definitions and canonical DS-036 Governance Dependency Graph rather than local transitional composite definitions. RTM/CR traceability synchronized to RTM-1.46 by adding RTM-00008;RTM-00009 and CR-008;CR-009. Reverse schema dependency metadata synchronized to the active forward schema_dependencies graph in Schema Catalog 1.0.44.

title: Governance Context Envelope
description: Canonical domain schema for the attributable, versioned governance-relevant context associated with a Governed Action Proposal. The envelope preserves identity, tenant, policy, evidence, delegation, authority, lineage, target, lifecycle, risk, handoff, coordination, and outcome relationships needed for governance evaluation and continuity. Context may inform governance but is not authoritative Canonical State and cannot override it.
rtm_mapping_basis: Relationship-specific semantic review of context integrity, lineage, handoff, Canonical State non-override, evidence continuity, attribution, and coordination requirements; synchronized in RTM-1.9.
notes: Canonical Governance Context Envelope. Delegation, Authority Lineage, approval, refusal, qualified-evidence, and dependency-graph references resolve to their canonical DS schemas; inline Canonical State remains prohibited.

title: Canonical State
description: Canonical domain schema for the single qualified and authoritative governance representation of operational reality used for a defined evaluation horizon. Canonical State is resolved deterministically from qualified authoritative governance sources; is distinct from Governance Context, runtime observations, telemetry, local state, and agent belief; and references the independently traceable DS-032 State Qualification Result used to establish suitability for governance evaluation.
rtm_mapping_basis: Relationship-specific semantic review of Canonical State availability, freshness, single-state conflict resolution, precedence over non-authoritative observations, and State Qualification; synchronized in RTM-1.10.
notes: Canonical State uses the qualification_result property to carry an integrity-bound DS-032 State Qualification Result reference constrained to outcome QUALIFIED. The former embedded top-level qualification result is not retained. Reverse schema dependency metadata synchronized to the active forward schema_dependencies graph in Schema Catalog 1.0.44.

title: Authority Lineage
description: Canonical domain schema for the complete, attributable, integrity-protected chain through which the evidentiary basis for authority is originated, delegated, approved, constrained, revoked, re-established, and validated for a specific proposed transition. Authority Lineage remains bound to Proposal Identity, target, tenant, governance domain, scope, lifecycle, validity, Canonical State, policy, and evidence. It supports deterministic reconstruction and Authority Re-Derivation but is not portable executable authority and does not itself constitute authority at commitment or permission to execute.
rtm_mapping_basis: Relationship-specific semantic review of verifiable delegation references, deterministic lineage integrity, mission/task continuity, delegation-chain completeness, attribution consistency, provenance continuity, recursive authority containment, and cross-domain authority isolation; synchronized in RTM-1.12.
notes: Implemented as the canonical evidentiary authority-chain object. It aggregates DS-025 delegation references, preserves origin, approval, mission/task, scope, revocation, subject eligibility, domain-segment, and replay-protection relationships, and remains evidence for Authority Re-Derivation rather than portable execution authority. Reverse schema dependency metadata synchronized to the active forward schema_dependencies graph in Schema Catalog 1.0.44.

title: Delegation Artifact
description: Canonical domain schema for an independently verifiable artifact recording bounded authority delegated from one governance principal to another. A Delegation Artifact preserves source authority, scope attenuation, validity, revocation controls, tenant and governance-domain boundaries, target binding, recursive-delegation limits, cross-domain escalation evidence, attribution, integrity, and lineage continuity. It is evidence used during Authority Re-Derivation and does not itself constitute unconditional authority at commitment or permission to execute.
rtm_mapping_basis: Relationship-specific semantic review of verifiable delegation references, deterministic artifact integrity, delegation-chain continuity, attribution consistency, provenance continuity, governed cross-domain transition, and recursive authority containment; synchronized in RTM-1.11.
notes: Implemented as an immutable delegation-evidence object. Current authority, revocation, expiration, subject eligibility, and commit-time admissibility are re-derived from current qualified governance inputs. DS-022 now uses the DS-025 reference definition. Authority Lineage references now resolve through canonical DS-024.

title: Governance Approval Artifact
description: Canonical domain schema for an attributable, cryptographically verifiable governance artifact recording human or governed approval, cosignature, positive or negative adjudication, risk acceptance, cancellation, withdrawal, or participation in partial or completed quorum. The artifact is proposal-, lifecycle-, scope-, tenant-, target-, policy-, governance-version-, and validity-bound evidence. It may support lifecycle progression, Authority Re-Derivation, and Commit-Bound Admissibility, but does not itself constitute authority at commitment or permission to execute.
rtm_mapping_basis: Relationship-specific semantic mapping approved for approval, adjudication, quorum, expiration, cancellation, and escalation requirements in RTM-1.13.
notes: Authoritative DS-026 AGCP-created or AGCP-qualified Governance Approval Artifact. It requires artifact_origin=AGCP_CREATED_OR_QUALIFIED and is not accepted as IF-001 ingress. DS-016 remains permanently retired; DS-045 is the separate active submission schema.

title: Governance Receipt
description: Canonical attributable and integrity-protected record of a non-refusal AGCP governance result. A Governance Receipt binds a Governed Action Proposal and its qualified governance basis to the recorded decision, authorization, approval or adjudication, commitment, enforcement, execution outcome, lifecycle transition, continuation outcome, or governed re-evaluation result. It is governance evidence rather than a mere application response and does not itself create authority at commitment or permission to execute. Structural Refusal is documented through a Refusal Record, not this schema.
rtm_mapping_basis: Relationship-specific semantic mapping approved for canonical-state, governing-constraint, integrity, attribution, replay, evidence-continuity, evidence-availability, and independent-verification receipt requirements in RTM-1.14.
notes: Authoritative DS-027 canonical Governance Receipt for non-refusal governance results. Structural Refusal remains exclusively documented by DS-028 Refusal Record.

title: Refusal Record
description: Canonical attributable, integrity-protected, ledger-recorded, and replay-verifiable record documenting Structural Refusal and the governance basis that prevented a proposed transition from becoming operationally real. A Refusal Record is distinct from a policy denial, authorization failure, commit failure, transport error, warning, score, recommendation, or audit note.
rtm_mapping_basis: Exact DS-to-requirement assignments derived from the authoritative RTM-1.46 DS_ID column; the catalog records the corresponding RTM_ID and CR_ID sets without omission or addition.
notes: Authoritative DS-028 canonical Refusal Record for Structural Refusal. Policy denial, authorization failure, commit failure, deferral, and re-evaluation remain non-refusal results unless a separate Structural Refusal is applied. RTM/CR traceability synchronized to RTM-1.46 by adding RTM-00009 and CR-009. Reverse schema dependency metadata synchronized to the active forward schema_dependencies graph in Schema Catalog 1.0.44.

title: Enforcement Context
description: Canonical, independently identifiable and traceable integrity-protected enforcement-facing projection of the completed governance basis supplied by the Governance Realization Function to a specific Policy Enforcement Point. It binds the proposal, decision, authorization, current proposal-specific authority, qualified evidence, target, Tenant, policy, qualified Canonical State, lifecycle state, scope, validity, Governance Version, resulting-state validation, composite conditions, and Governance Binding Validation needed to apply the decision correctly. Enforcement Context does not replace Canonical State, the Governance Context Envelope, or Governance Evidence and does not itself create authority, authorize execution, or commit a transition.
rtm_mapping_basis: Relationship-specific semantic mapping approved for Enforcement Context availability, Enforcement Decision Integrity, and Governance Enforcement Binding in RTM-1.24.
notes: Canonical DS-029 Enforcement Context assembled from the completed qualified governance basis and supplied to a specific Policy Enforcement Point. It preserves Governance Enforcement Binding, supports fail-closed mismatch detection, and does not replace source governance objects or independently create authority, authorization, execution, or commitment.

title: Governance Binding Validation Result
description: Canonical, independently identifiable and traceable commit-time result confirming that the proposal remains bound to the same governance decision, execution authorization, current proposal-specific authority, qualified evidence, target, Tenant, governance domain, policy, qualified Canonical State, Derived Lifecycle State, scope, validity window, Governance Version, and applicable composite bind conditions evaluated by governance.
rtm_mapping_basis: Relationship-specific semantic mapping approved for Governance Realization, composite pre-bind re-evaluation, and governed partial-binding continuity in RTM-1.23.
notes: Canonical DS-030 commit-time Governance Binding Validation result. It compares the previously evaluated binding with current qualified governance inputs across proposal, decision, authorization, authority, evidence, target, Tenant, policy, Canonical State, lifecycle, scope, validity, Governance Version, and composite bind conditions. It permits Enforcement Context assembly only when all applicable dimensions remain intact and does not itself authorize, enforce, or commit execution.

title: Resulting-State Validation Result
description: Canonical, independently identifiable and traceable pre-commit validation of the projected aggregate state produced by one governed transition, a complete Bind Set, or an explicitly governed executable subset. The result preserves applicable constraints, invariants, dependency and coupling conditions, qualified Canonical State, aggregate effects, deterministic projection, attribution, integrity, and replay. It contributes to Commit-Bound Admissibility but does not establish authority, authorize execution, select an executable subset, or commit a transition.
rtm_mapping_basis: Relationship-specific semantic mapping approved for Governance Realization support and explicit determination that a complete or partial transition set preserves acceptable projected resulting state in RTM-1.21.
notes: Canonical DS-031 pre-commit Resulting-State Validation. It evaluates deterministic projected aggregate state for a single transition, complete Bind Set, or explicitly governed executable subset; preserves constraints, invariants, dependency and coupling conditions; and blocks commitment when the state is invalid or indeterminate. It is not authority, authorization, subset selection, or commitment.

title: State Qualification Result
description: Canonical, independently identifiable and traceable result of evaluating whether governance-relevant information is suitable for inclusion in or use as Canonical State for a defined evaluation horizon. The result records freshness, provenance, completeness, consistency, integrity, availability, conflict resolution, and ordering suitability; distinguishes qualified, not-qualified, and indeterminate outcomes; and prevents admissibility from proceeding when Canonical State suitability is not established.
rtm_mapping_basis: Relationship-specific semantic mapping approved for Canonical State availability, freshness, conflict resolution, and pre-admissibility State Qualification requirements in RTM-1.16.
notes: Extracted from the transitional State Qualification model embedded in DS-023. DS-032 now records qualified, not-qualified, and indeterminate outcomes; DS-023 accepts only the qualified outcome. Reverse schema dependency metadata synchronized to the active forward schema_dependencies graph in Schema Catalog 1.0.44.

title: Evidence Qualification Result
description: Canonical, independently identifiable and traceable result of determining whether the evidence required for a governance decision is sufficiently fresh, provenanced, integrity-verifiable, authoritative, resolvable, sufficient, and available for the specific proposal, action, target, tenant, policy, and evaluation horizon. Evidence that is not qualified cannot support admissibility or authority merely because an artifact or reference exists.
rtm_mapping_basis: Relationship-specific semantic mapping approved for evidence provenance, reference resolvability, sufficiency, integrity, change detection, availability, and pre-admissibility Evidence Qualification requirements in RTM-1.17.
notes: Canonical DS-033 Evidence Qualification result. The schema externalizes the transitional shared model, adds mandatory availability qualification, supports qualified, not-qualified, and indeterminate outcomes, and supplies the canonical qualified_evidence_ref used by active governance schemas. Reverse schema dependency metadata synchronized to the active forward schema_dependencies graph in Schema Catalog 1.0.44.

title: Authority Rederivation Result
description: Canonical, independently identifiable and traceable result of re-deriving proposal-specific authority immediately before commitment from current qualified governance inputs. The result evaluates current Canonical State, Authority Lineage, Delegation Artifacts, Governance Approval Artifacts, qualified evidence, authorization, target, tenant, governance domain, lifecycle, scope, validity, revocation, subject eligibility, recursive containment, and cross-domain isolation. It precedes Commit-Bound Admissibility and Governance Binding Validation and does not itself grant permission to execute.
rtm_mapping_basis: Relationship-specific semantic mapping approved for current tenant and subject status, non-portable prior authorization, current Canonical State, continued governing assumptions, direct commit-time Authority Re-Derivation, Recursive Authority Containment, and Cross-Domain Authority Isolation requirements in RTM-1.18.
notes: Canonical DS-034 commit-time Authority Re-Derivation result. It consumes current qualified Canonical State and evidence, Authority Lineage, Delegation Artifacts, Governance Approval Artifacts, authorization, target, tenant, lifecycle, scope, validity, revocation, recursive-containment, and cross-domain conditions. It is proposal-specific, non-portable, and precedes Commit-Bound Admissibility and Governance Binding Validation.

title: Bind Set
description: Canonical, independently identifiable and traceable complete candidate collection of governed sub-transitions evaluated as a coordinated governance unit. A Bind Set preserves parent and sub-transition identity, target, Tenant, governance domain, declared coupling semantics, Governance Dependency Graph binding, aggregate-effect basis, and partial-binding policy. It supplies the complete evaluation context for coordinated binding but does not itself establish authority, authorize execution, determine Partial-Bind Admissibility, or approve an executable subset.
rtm_mapping_basis: Relationship-specific semantic mapping approved for composite proposal representation, explicit coupling classification, and governed partial-bind consideration in RTM-1.20.
notes: Canonical DS-035 complete candidate Bind Set. It preserves parent/sub-transition identity, targets, authority domains, coupling semantics, DS-036 dependency-graph binding, aggregate-effect basis, and declared partial-binding policy. It does not establish authority, authorize execution, determine Partial-Bind Admissibility, or approve an executable subset.

title: Governance Dependency Graph
description: Canonical, independently identifiable and traceable structured representation of governance-significant dependency, prerequisite, ordering, authority, synchronization, consistency, execution, resource, policy, evidence, and state relationships among governed sub-transitions of a composite proposal. The graph makes dependencies explicit for composite evaluation, re-evaluation, Governance Binding Validation, Deterministic Adjudication, Partial-Bind Admissibility, Resulting-State Validation, coordinated enforcement, and replay. It does not itself establish authority, authorize execution, or determine partial-bind admissibility.
rtm_mapping_basis: Relationship-specific semantic mapping approved for explicit Governance Dependency Graph preservation and deterministic pre-bind re-evaluation following material dependency-condition change in RTM-1.19.
notes: Canonical DS-036 Governance Dependency Graph extracted from DS-021. It models explicit governed sub-transition nodes and typed dependency relationships, requires attributable graph validation and replay material, and mandates deterministic pre-bind re-evaluation after material dependency-condition change. It does not itself establish authority, authorize execution, or determine partial-bind admissibility.

title: Deterministic Adjudication Result
description: Canonical, independently identifiable and traceable result of resolving which candidate, if any, may proceed toward commitment when multiple currently admissible transitions contend within the same governance horizon. The result operates on a complete Admissible Set and applies explicit governance-significant ordering, conflict, dependency, resource, priority, state, and policy conditions rather than arrival timing or implementation-specific behavior. It may select one properly bound transition, a validated executable subset, no candidate, or an indeterminate outcome. It contributes to Governance Evidence and commitment processing but does not itself establish authority, authorize execution, validate Governance Binding, or commit a transition.
rtm_mapping_basis: Exact DS-to-requirement assignments derived from the authoritative RTM-1.46 DS_ID column; the catalog records the corresponding RTM_ID and CR_ID sets without omission or addition.
notes: Canonical DS-037 Deterministic Adjudication Result. It preserves a complete Admissible Set and resolves contention through explicit governance-significant ordering, conflict, dependency, resource, priority, state, and policy conditions. It prohibits arrival timing and implementation-specific behavior as governance bases and does not itself authorize, bind, or commit a transition. RTM/CR traceability synchronized to RTM-1.46 by adding RTM-00034 and CR-034.

title: Governance Lifecycle Record
description: Canonical attributable and integrity-protected record of Proposal Identity, authoritative Derived Lifecycle State, complete ordered transition history, transition basis, terminality, approval/refusal effects, expiration, cancellation, degradation, re-evaluation, recovery, commitment, and execution effects.
rtm_mapping_basis: Direct semantic implementation of externally retrievable Derived Lifecycle State, exclusion of transient internal state, permitted transition integrity, lifecycle-eligible approval use, expiration and cancellation, terminal non-repeatable execution, provenance continuity, escalation integration, lifecycle integrity, and nonterminal degraded-state semantics.
notes: Implemented for AGCP v2.0. DS-038 owns lifecycle record, lifecycle state, transition, terminality, and canonical lifecycle reference definitions. It derives lifecycle state from ordered ledger records, preserves complete transition basis and history, blocks transient-state exposure, makes executed Proposal Identity terminal and non-repeatable, and records degradation and governed re-evaluation without itself authorizing execution. Reverse schema dependency metadata synchronized to the active forward schema_dependencies graph in Schema Catalog 1.0.44.

title: Continuation Integrity Result
description: Canonical attributable and integrity-protected result for pre-commit Continuation Integrity, material-change assessment, affected-proposal risk-based re-evaluation, Admissible Path Viability, degradation, commitment suspension, Continuation Recovery, restoration, and governed terminal disposition.
rtm_mapping_basis: Direct semantic implementation of degraded-state detection, nonterminal degradation, required re-evaluation before authorization retention or commitment, continuation-basis preservation, admissible-path viability, degradation detection, governed recovery, composite dependency re-evaluation, and active risk-based re-evaluation.
